$comment: TypeIcon source manifest. Every imported asset group is pinned here with provenance. Importers refuse sources whose integrity does not match. See docs/policies/sources-and-licenses.md.

review.note: Original artwork authored with tools/core-authoring. Batches are published immediately and flagged for human design review (owner decision 2026-09-30).

sources.author: Simple Icons contributors
sources.copyright: Logos are trademarks of their respective owners; Simple Icons collection released under CC0-1.0
notices: Simple Icons states that CC0 applies to the collection but not necessarily to every logo; per-logo license data is recorded where available and share-alike, non-commercial, GPL and custom-licensed logos are quarantined.
Brand logos are trademarks. Use them only to refer to the brand and follow each brand's guidelines (guidelines links are recorded per logo). See assets/sources/licenses/simple-icons/DISCLAIMER.md.

attribution.text: Brand logos from Simple Icons (CC0-1.0), https://simpleicons.org. Trademarks belong to their owners.

sources.styleMappingNote: Brand logos are published in one style only. Logos are never redrawn as Filled, Line or Rounded variants.

review.note: Owner chose to import Simple Icons as the single exception to the original-only rule. Brands never count toward the Core goal.

modificationHistory: Converted to font outlines for the TypeIcon Brands font
